_about: Model Forge catalogue: every open-weight model the forge can download and run on its own GPU. Weights are fetched once into the models volume (FORGE_MODELS) and then used offline; nothing runs on Hugging Face Spaces or any hosted inference API. `worker` names the Python environment and worker script that runs it (server/workers/<worker>.py in venv /opt/forge/venv/<venv>).

hunyuan21.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D 2.1 (shape + PBR paint)
hunyuan21.quality: Best all-round detail with true PBR (albedo + metallic + roughness). Default.
hunyuan21.licence: Tencent Hunyuan Community Licence: free under 1M MAU, but NOT licensed in the EU, UK or South Korea.

hunyuan2mv.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D 2mv (shape from front/left/back photos) + 2.1 PBR paint
hunyuan2mv.quality: Use when you have several views of the same object (front, left, back, right): the most faithful shapes.
hunyuan2mv.licence: Tencent Hunyuan Community Licence (same territory limits as 2.1).

hunyuan2turbo.name: Tencent Hunyuan3D 2.0 Turbo + FlashVDM (fast drafts) + 2.1 PBR paint
hunyuan2turbo.quality: About 5x faster shape step. Good for blocking out lots of props quickly.
hunyuan2turbo.licence: Tencent Hunyuan Community Licence (same territory limits as 2.1).

trellis2.name: Microsoft TRELLIS.2 4B (shape + PBR in one pass)
trellis2.quality: Very high resolution geometry (up to 1536^3 voxels) with PBR. MIT licence, fine everywhere.
trellis2.licence: MIT (helper models: DINOv3 under Meta's DINOv3 licence, BiRefNet MIT).

triposg.name: VAST TripoSG 1.5B (sharp shape) + Hunyuan3D 2.1 PBR paint
triposg.quality: Crisp hard-surface geometry (furniture, machines, signs). Shape is MIT; paint step is Hunyuan.
triposg.licence: MIT shape; Hunyuan Community Licence for the paint step.

flux-schnell.name: FLUX.1 [schnell] (text to reference image, 4 steps)
flux-schnell.prompt_template: {prompt}. Single object, whole object in frame, centred, three-quarter front view, photorealistic product photograph, physically accurate materials, soft even studio lighting, plain pure white background, no shadow, no text, no people
